annotations.text: A — Stacked Tiles: little layered paper tiles in poco's own palette, literalizing "modular micro-entries." Friendly and abstract; doesn't reference tasks/journal directly.
B — Folded Note: a task note with a checkmark badge, tied straight to what the app does. More literal; reads closer to other note/task-app icons.
C — Geometric "p": a clean, ownable glyph mark. Scales best to tiny sizes (favicon, tray); most abstract, no task/modularity hint.
